newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL noon rubber little changed, currency factor.
newsitem.headline: KL noon rubber little changed, currency factor.

text.p: Rubber prices in Malaysia were little changed at noon as the market was influenced by regional currencies movements, dealers said.
"The market was rather quiet this morning. People are still cautious by the curreny movements," a trader said, adding that buyers are keeping at the sidelines while waiting for attractive prices.
The ringgit weakened against the U.S. dollar and this could help to underpin sentiment, they said.
"There were scattered inquiries and I wouldn't expect much deals due to currency factors," a dealer said.
Dealers offered SMR CV at 294 cents, SMR L at 275, SMR 5 at 254, SMR 10 at 248 and SMR 20 at 246 and latex at 190.
There are sufficient stocks to satisfy demand, but dealers said they expect a tight supply in the near-term.
Malaysia-based shipping brokers quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $700 per 20-ft container, and $1,400 per 40-ft container.
At noon, August Int. Ones RSS buyer was unchanged at 248.50 cents (94 U.S.cents) and August SMR 20 buyer up half a cent at 248. -Tan Lee Lee -603 275-6834 ($1-2.6360)
